stories.headline: Cerebras Files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO, Reports $510M Revenue and First Profit in 2025

key_facts.fact: Cerebras filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the SEC on April 17 for a proposed IPO of its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under ticker symbol 'CBRS'
key_facts.excerpt: Cerebras Systems Inc. today announced that it has filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to a proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

key_facts.fact: Cerebras reported 2025 revenue of $510 million (up 76% from $290.3 million) and net income of $87.9 million, versus a net loss of $484.8 million in 2024
key_facts.excerpt: The Sunnyvale, California-based company had net income of $87.9 million on revenue of $510 million for 2025, compared with a net loss of $484.8 million on revenue of $290.3 million a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: Morgan Stanley, Citigroup, Barclays, and UBS Investment Bank are lead book-running managers; Mizuho and TD Cowen act as bookrunners
key_facts.excerpt: Morgan Stanley, Citigroup, Barclays, and UBS Investment Bank will act as lead book-running managers for the proposed offering. Mizuho and TD Cowen will act as bookrunners.

key_facts.fact: This is Cerebras' second IPO attempt after withdrawing a previous filing in October 2024 following a US national security review of UAE-based G42's minority investment
key_facts.excerpt: This is the company's second attempt to list after it withdrew a previous IPO filing in October, days after a more than $1 billion fundraise that valued it at about $8 billion.

key_facts.fact: Cerebras' growth is tied to OpenAI, including a $20 billion multi-year deal under which OpenAI will deploy 750 megawatts of Cerebras chips for inference
key_facts.excerpt: It is focused on inference, the process by which AI systems respond to user queries, and has tied much of its growth to OpenAI, including a $20 billion multi-year deal under which the ChatGPT creator will deploy 750 megawatts of Cerebras chips.

key_facts.fact: Cerebras' WSE-3 is the world's largest commercialized AI processor, 58 times larger than a leading GPU chip, delivering inference up to 15 times faster than GPU-based solutions
key_facts.excerpt: Our flagship technology, the Wafer-Scale Engine 3 (WSE-3) is the world's largest and fastest commercialized AI processor. 58 times larger than a leading GPU chip, the WSE-3 uses a fraction of the power per unit compute while delivering inference up to 15 times faster than leading GPU-based solutions.

stories.headline: Kairos Power Breaks Ground on Hermes 2, First Gen IV Nuclear Reactor With US Construction Permit

key_facts.fact: Kairos Power broke ground on April 17 on the Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant in Oak Ridge, Tennessee — the first commercial-scale Gen IV reactor to receive a US construction permit
key_facts.excerpt: Kairos Power broke ground on the Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant in Oak Ridge on Friday. It is the first commercial-scale reactor and the first power-producing Generation IV reactor to receive a U.S. construction permit.

key_facts.fact: The reactor uses molten fluoride salt coolant with specialty fuel, building on technology rooted in Oak Ridge's 1960s Molten Salt Reactor Experiment
key_facts.excerpt: The Hermes reactor design uses molten fluoride salt coolant along with a specialty fuel to generate power.

key_facts.fact: Once completed, the plant is expected to generate up to 50 megawatts for the TVA power system, powering Google's data centers in Tennessee and Alabama
key_facts.excerpt: Once completed, the plant is expected to generate up to 50 megawatts for the TVA power system, powering Google's data centers in Tennessee and Alabama.

key_facts.fact: TVA expects the first reactor at Hermes 2 to begin operating in 2030, with further capacity by 2035; TVA is the first US utility to buy electricity from a Gen IV reactor
key_facts.excerpt: The TVA expects one reactor at Hermes 2 to begin operating in 2030, with the company adding further capacity by 2035. The TVA is the first U.S. utility to sign an agreement to buy electricity from a Gen IV reactor.

key_facts.fact: The plant is built on the former Oak Ridge Gaseous Diffusion Plant K-33 site, next to the Hermes 1 test reactor (expected operational 2028)
key_facts.excerpt: Leaders with Kairos Power broke ground on Hermes 2, a fluoride salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor designed to produce electricity. The company said the project builds on lessons from Hermes 1, which is already under construction and serving as a test reactor.

key_facts.fact: Deputy Secretary of Energy James Danly attended the groundbreaking, saying the DOE is 'partnering with all manner of different companies to get as much nuclear power development as possible'
key_facts.excerpt: The Department of Energy, under the president's mandate to accelerate nuclear power, has been, partnering with all manner of different companies to get as much nuclear power development as possible, as quickly as possible.

stories.headline: Crusoe Announces 900 MW AI Factory Campus in Abilene, Texas for Microsoft

key_facts.fact: Crusoe announced a new 900 MW AI factory campus in Abilene, Texas, dedicated to supporting large-scale AI workloads for Microsoft, with total site capacity expected to reach 2.1 GW
key_facts.excerpt: Neocloud provider Crusoe announced a new 900 MW AI factory campus in Abilene, Texas, dedicated to supporting large-scale AI workloads for Microsoft, with the total site capacity expected to reach 2.1 GW.

key_facts.fact: The campus will consist of two new buildings and an on-site ~900 MW power plant with water-efficient cooling systems
key_facts.excerpt: The campus will consist of two new buildings and a powerplant on-site providing grid resilience as well supporting next-gen AI infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: Construction has begun, with the first building planned to be operational by mid-2027
key_facts.excerpt: Construction has begun, with the first building planned to be operational by mid-2027, maintaining Crusoe's rapid pace of infrastructure buildout.

key_facts.fact: CEO Chase Lochmiller said Crusoe is 'building the industrial foundation for American AI — at a velocity the industry has never seen' by integrating 900 MW of on-site power generation
key_facts.excerpt: By integrating 900 megawatts of new on-site power generation, we will continue building the industrial foundation for American AI – at a velocity the industry has never seen.

stories.headline: Meta Paid Broadcom $2.3B in 2025 for Custom AI Chip Design; CEO Hock Tan Leaves Meta Board

key_facts.fact: Meta Platforms paid Broadcom $2.3 billion in 2025, disclosed in a securities filing triggered by Broadcom CEO Hock Tan's presence on the Meta board
key_facts.excerpt: Meta Platforms paid Broadcom $2.3 billion in 2025, Meta disclosed in a securities filing, a rare disclosure of how much tech firms pay Broadcom for help designing their AI chips.

key_facts.fact: Hock Tan is leaving the Meta board, resolving the conflict of interest between his CEO role at Broadcom and his board seat at one of Broadcom's largest customers
key_facts.excerpt: In disclosures due to Broadcom CEO Hock Tan's presence on the Meta board, Meta says it paid Broadcom $2.3B in 2025; Tan is leaving the board.

key_facts.fact: The disclosure is a rare glimpse into how much hyperscalers pay Broadcom for custom AI chip design work, as Broadcom designs custom accelerators (XPUs) for major cloud providers
key_facts.excerpt: Meta Platforms paid Broadcom $2.3 billion in 2025, Meta disclosed in a securities filing, a rare disclosure of how much tech firms pay Broadcom for help designing their AI chips.

stories.headline: AGIBOT Unveils 5 New Robot Platforms Including First L3 Autonomous Quadruped, Passes 10,000 Robots

key_facts.fact: AGIBOT announced 5 new robotic platforms at its 2026 Partner Conference on April 17 in Shanghai, including humanoid, mobile manipulator, quadruped, and dexterous hand designs
key_facts.excerpt: AGIBOT unveiled 5 new robotic platforms designed to support diverse real-world scenarios, from entertainment and retail to industrial operations and field inspection.

key_facts.fact: The AGIBOT A3 humanoid stands 173 cm tall, weighs 55 kg, uses magnesium, titanium, and TPU materials for an industry-leading 0.218 kW/kg power-to-weight ratio, with 10-hour endurance and 10-second battery swap
key_facts.excerpt: Standing 173 cm tall and weighing just 55 kg with elegant golden-ratio aesthetics, it utilizes lightweight magnesium, titanium, and TPU materials to achieve an industry-leading 0.218 kW/kg power-to-weight ratio.

key_facts.fact: The D2 Max is described as the world's first all-terrain Level 3 autonomous quadruped robot, designed for security patrol, industrial inspection, emergency rescue, and logistics
key_facts.excerpt: AGIBOT's next-generation flagship quadruped robot, the D2 Max, is the world's first all-terrain Level 3 autonomous quadruped robot, defining a new standard for AGI-driven autonomous operation.

key_facts.fact: In March 2026, AGIBOT announced the rollout of its 10,000th robot, marking a major milestone in large-scale production and deployment
key_facts.excerpt: In March 2026, AGIBOT announced the rollout of its 10,000th robot, marking a major milestone in large-scale production and deployment.

key_facts.fact: CTO Peng Zhihui said 'Embodied intelligence is no longer a concept, it is becoming a new form of productive infrastructure' as the company shifts from showcasing capabilities to delivering results
key_facts.excerpt: Embodied intelligence is no longer a concept, it is becoming a new form of productive infrastructure.

stories.headline: ASML Alum's Euclyd Seeks €100M+ to Build European AI Inference Chip Challenging Nvidia

key_facts.fact: Dutch startup Euclyd, founded in 2024 by former ASML director Bernardo Kastrup, is negotiating with investors to raise at least €100 million to scale its AI inference chip technology
key_facts.excerpt: Euclyd, founded in 2024 by former ASML director Bernardo Kastrup, is negotiating with investors to raise at least €100 million, according to CNBC.

key_facts.fact: Euclyd's product CRAFTWERK is a chip system designed specifically for AI inference that processes data simultaneously across multiple locations, claiming 100x greater power efficiency than Nvidia's Vera Rubin chips
key_facts.excerpt: The company claims its system delivers 100 times greater power efficiency for inference than NVIDIA's latest Vera Rubin chips, though this figure has not been validated through large-scale commercial deployment.

key_facts.fact: Euclyd's advisory board includes former ASML CEO Peter Wennink; the company previously secured a seed round under €10 million
key_facts.excerpt: Euclyd's advisory board adds significant credibility. Its backers include former ASML CEO Peter Wennink.

key_facts.fact: Kastrup worked at Philips Research, Silicon Hive (later acquired by Intel), and ASML before founding Euclyd in 2024 after seeing a lack of European efforts in next-gen inference silicon
key_facts.excerpt: Kastrup, a computer scientist and philosopher, previously worked at Philips Research, Silicon Hive (later acquired by Intel), and ASML, focusing on product strategy.

key_facts.fact: Euclyd is in discussions with four potential clients, aiming to supply two next year and two the year after; a multi-chiplet version is expected by 2028
key_facts.excerpt: Euclyd is in discussions with four potential clients, aiming to supply two next year and two the year after.

stories.headline: US Tech Companies Successfully Lobbied EU to Weaken Data Center Emissions Transparency Rules

key_facts.fact: An investigation by The Guardian and Investigate Europe found that US tech companies including Microsoft successfully lobbied the EU to hide data centers' environmental toll
key_facts.excerpt: US tech companies successfully lobbied the EU to hide data centers' environmental toll.

key_facts.fact: One of the corporate demands was written 'almost verbatim' into EU rules governing data center emissions reporting
key_facts.excerpt: One of their demands was written almost verbatim into EU rules.

key_facts.fact: The lobbying effort targeted EU rules that would have required greater transparency about the environmental impact of the rapidly expanding data center industry
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft, US tech firms lobbied EU secrecy rules datacentre emissions.
